essence: The practitioner must first satisfy Agni and the other deities by presenting offerings.
The goddess is to be visualized in a terrifying form, impaled on a spear tip and adorned with a garland of human heads.
The goddess is visualized as repeatedly striking the host of enemies on a stone with a firebrand in her hand.
While absorbed in meditation, the practitioner should go far away and release the staff.
The practitioner must bathe, become pure, and stand in water up to the throat.
